details: Like the fall back avatar system for quest users but for everyone. Setting a default avatar basically for anyone but your friends to see. This would also HIGHLY crack down on local avatar ripping (once you load into a world and others load to see your avatar, your avatar is then loaded on their local computer and could be un encrypted to be stolen) Letting only my friends see my avatar that iv paid/worked on. Could even be implemented like the safety and trust system. Just think this would be a good feature to be added.
title: Control who sees my avatar.
